# Vendored FTTransformer source

This directory contains the Python package source snapshot used
by the transfusion FTTransformer experiments.

Package metadata reported by the experimental environment:
- Distribution: tab-transformer-pytorch
- Version: 0.6.1
- Installation mode: editable
- Original local source: tab-transformer-pytorch-main

The original source directory did not contain Git metadata.
Therefore, the exact upstream commit and equivalence to the
published 0.6.1 release have not been established.

The upstream LICENSE file is retained with this source snapshot.
Runtime dependencies must be installed separately; see the
repository's environment documentation.
